instagram.caption:
Silicon chips are hitting a heat wall that slows down every device you own 🥵

A team called Discovered Materials built an algorithm that plays whack-a-mole with heat, hunting for hidden superconductors that shouldn't work—but do. Nobody knows why yet.

Their trick: skip the long lab testing phase and turn simulations straight into faster chip designs. That means your next phone or laptop could run cooler without waiting years for new materials.

For you, this shortens the gap between "what's possible" and "what you can actually buy"—especially if you're choosing hardware for creative work soon.

Run your next upgrade through their simulation pipeline before you commit—what would you test first? 🔍
